assessment: When selecting for one particular trait, it is not uncommon for other traits to change. This is due to pleiotropic mutations that affect multiple characters. Ardell and Kryazhimskiy develop a theoretical framework to predict adaptive trajectories observed in environments other than the one selection is operating in. The effects of adaptation across environments have important implication to antibiotic treatments, where resistance evolution to one antibiotic can alter the susceptibility to other antibiotics.
